dashboards_data.name: NodeZero Overview
dashboards_data.description: Shows NodeZero weakness events from completed pentests, for all pentests or the ones picked in the Pentest filter: key weakness counts, ingestion health, weaknesses by severity, impact and category, and the most common weaknesses and most affected hosts.

data.phrase: dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter severity = "CRITICAL" | comp count() as Critical | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Critical seriestitle("Critical","Critical weaknesses")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter vuln_cisa_kev = true | comp count() as KEV | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = KEV seriestitle("KEV","CISA KEV weaknesses")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter vuln_known_ransomware_campaign_use = true | comp count() as Ransomware | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Ransomware seriestitle("Ransomware","Known ransomware weaknesses")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | filter has_proof = true | comp count() as Proven | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Proven seriestitle("Proven","Weaknesses with proof")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | alter day = format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", _insert_time) | comp count() as Events by day | sort asc day | view graph type = column subtype = grouped header = "Events ingested per day" xaxis = day yaxis = Events

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | comp count_distinct(op_id) as Pentests | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Pentests seriestitle("Pentests","Pentests ingested")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | comp max(_insert_time) as last_insert | alter Hours = timestamp_diff(current_time(), last_insert, "HOUR") | fields Hours | view graph type = single subtype = standard yaxis = Hours scale_threshold("#25cf68","#eac016","24","#f11126","72") seriestitle("Hours","Hours since last ingest")

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | comp count() as Events, max(pentest_weaknesses_count) as Expected, max(_insert_time) as Last_ingested by Pentest, pentest_etl_completed_at | alter Match = if(Events = Expected, "yes", "no") | sort desc pentest_etl_completed_at

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | comp count() as Weaknesses by severity | view graph type = pie header = "Weaknesses by severity" xaxis = severity yaxis = Weaknesses

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | alter Impact = json_extract_scalar_array(downstream_impact_types, "$") | arrayexpand Impact | filter Impact != null | comp count() as Weaknesses by Impact | sort desc Weaknesses | view graph type = column subtype = grouped layout = horizontal header = "Weaknesses by downstream impact" xaxis = Impact yaxis = Weaknesses

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | comp count() as Weaknesses by vuln_category | sort desc Weaknesses | view graph type = pie header = "Weaknesses by category" xaxis = vuln_category yaxis = Weaknesses

dataset = horizon3_nodezero_raw | alter Pentest = concat(replace(coalesce(pentest_name, "Unnamed pentest"), "\"", "'"), " (", format_timestamp("%Y-%m-%d", pentest_etl_completed_at), ") · ", op_id) | filter Pentest in ($pentests) | dedup event_id by desc _insert_time | alter Host = coalesce(target_hostname, target_fqdn, target_ipv4_addresses), crit = if(severity = "CRITICAL", 1, 0), high = if(severity = "HIGH", 1, 0) | comp count() as Weaknesses, sum(crit) as Critical, sum(high) as High by Host | sort desc Weaknesses | limit 25
